grid: equal-angle, cell-centred, row 0 at the north; cell (r, c) covers lat 90-(r+1)s..90-r*s, lon -180+c*s..-180+(c+1)*s; level 0 s = 1/2 degree (720 x 360), level 1 s = 1/8 degree (2880 x 1440); row-major, gzip

population.citation: Schiavina, Marcello; Freire, Sergio; Carioli, Alessandra; MacManus, Kytt (2023): GHS-POP R2023A - GHS population grid multitemporal (1975-2030). European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC). doi:10.2905/2FF68A52-5B5B-4A22-8F40-C41DA8332CFE

levels.encoding: uint8 code k: 0 = under 0.1 person; k>=1 -> 10^(-1 + (k-0.5)*8/255) people; rescale each 4x4 block to its level-0 value
